researchQuestion: Does the inherited R6 same-fact reveal-order intervention transfer from one Agent-observer class to human observers without changing the mechanism family, question family, or initial-viewport evidence rule?

humanStimulusPlan.generation: cryptographically random master seed generated only after preregistration; private seed and oracle stored outside Git with mode 0600
humanStimulusPlan.scheduleAssignment: private-salt deterministic assignment over a pseudonymous participant id; one variant per mechanism; permutations balance mechanism×variant across six schedules
humanStimulusPlan.participantExposure: only the assigned variant and public questions; no oracle, seed, variant label, hypothesis wording, or alternative variant text

preflightPlan.browser: Web R6 encounter harness checks exact initial-viewport evidence sets and receipt integrity
preflightPlan.surrogate: Harness deepseek-v4-flash structured completion; two replicates per mechanism×variant; used only to detect broken task/oracle/wiring, never to tune or select human stimuli

humanResponseShape.confidenceSemantics: confidence0to100 means confidence that the selected response is justified by the evidence shown, so calibration is evaluated against epistemic decision accuracy rather than hidden factual truth alone.

primaryOutcome: R6-comparable factual adaptation accuracy: for Q4-Q6, optionId equals the mechanism oracle answer even when the assigned viewport lacks evidence required to justify that answer.
secondaryOutcomes: epistemic decision accuracy: choose the factual oracle when required evidence is visible and O4 when it is not
confidence calibration against epistemic decision accuracy
unsupportedInferenceRule: A substantive option selected when the exact assigned initial-viewport evidence lacks all required evidence is an unsupported inference even if the substantive option happens to equal the factual oracle.
decisionRules: HR0-v2 uses the exact H1-H3 participant/oracle digests frozen by seal commit fb9b4ab; any regenerated human stimulus invalidates v2.
HR0-A v2 passes only if the already frozen browser preflight remains exact and 12/12 fresh Harness surrogate Runs over P1/P2 produce structured conclusions with no equipment/protocol failure.
Surrogate factual accuracy and unsupported-inference rates are descriptive apparatus-falsification context. They do not tune/select H1-H3 and do not become human evidence.
Human primary factual adaptation accuracy must remain separate from unsupported inference and epistemic decision accuracy; no composite human-understanding score is permitted.
Any participant known to have seen hypothesis or variant identities beforehand is non-naive and supports only apparatus/local calibration.
HR0-v2 makes no population-level human effect claim. Population inference requires a future preregistration with an independent-evaluator sampling/analysis plan.
No raw identifiable participant record enters Git; no delayed recall, diagram, trust, preference, affect, or interaction claim is inferred from this bridge.
stoppingRules: Stop before human use if the sealed bundle commitment cannot be reproduced from the private files or any private oracle leaks into participant material.
Stop and revise under a new contract version if browser geometry changes the expected R6 viewport-evidence sets.
Stop and revise if preflight exposes ambiguous/broken questions; do not patch the sealed human stimuli in place.
A participant may stop at any time; incomplete pilot data remain private and are not reinterpreted as negative outcome evidence.

revisionFromV1.reason: v1 collapsed factual answer accuracy into evidence-sufficiency abstention; v2 restores R6 consequence separation
